title: Heather Cox Richardson on How the Trump Administration is Pursuing ‘A Nazi Worldview’
author: John Harwood
content:
What does it mean to be an American? MAGA Republicans in the White House and
Congress have been pushing an increasingly narrow view on who makes the cut,
as the Trump administration
[expands](https://www.cnn.com/2025/12/16/politics/travel-ban-trump-expands-
countries) the travel ban and congressmen like Randy Fine
[call](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2025/12/15/republicans-muslim-
mass-expulsions/) for the mass expulsion of Muslim Americans.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe?)

**Heather Cox Richardson** , author of the newsletter ['Letters from an
American'](https://heathercoxrichardson.substack.com/)_,_ spoke with **Zeteo
's John Harwood** about the two visions of America that have competed
throughout our history: the welcoming message of freedom and equality for all
etched on the Statue of Liberty, and the crimped conception of "real
Americans" preserving power over their "inferiors."

The conversation between Richardson and Harwood was live on
[Zeteo.com](http://zeteo.com/) and the Substack app, and both took questions
from subscribers in the live audience. Please share your thoughts on the
discussion in the comments below, and be sure to keep an eye out for the next
Substack Live.
